name: kb_feedback
description: Downvote a KB entry that proved wrong in practice: { id, reason, role? }. Marks the entry stale=1 + flagged_for_review=1 and appends an ASCII feedback note "[feedback <ISO>] <validated-role>: <reason>" (CONTENT_CAP respected). NEVER deletes and NEVER touches confidence -- a downvoted CONFIRMED entry stays CONFIRMED-but-stale-flagged; the human resolves it in kb-review, this tool only flags it for that review. Exception: an ACTIVE user-directive is flagged for review but NOT staled (directives outrank agent experience -- the human decides); a pending directive proposal stales normally. Not available in a MEMBER session: it returns E-MEMBER-VIEW-READ-ONLY and changes nothing. Scope: always the calling session's own KB -- a member session uses its registered work folder, any other session the fleet server's working folder; there is no repo/path scope argument (the removed repo_path, repo and repo_remote_url keys fail with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED). Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER, E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO or E-SELF-NO-REMOTE (each with a one-line remediation) when that folder cannot carry a KB identity (it must be a git repository with an origin remote).
